judgments.reason: The paper title and abstract describe the acquisition of electrophysiological and behavioral measures using an auditory oddball paradigm, directly matching the content of the Young Adult Resting State and Auditory Oddball Task EEG Data.
judgments.paper_title: Electroencephalography, pupillometry, and behavioral evidence for locus coeruleus-noradrenaline system related tonic hyperactivity in older adults
